faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtext: Find answers to common questions about our pricing plans.

1.question: Can I switch plans at any time?
1.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. When upgrading, new features will be immediately available. When downgrading, the change will take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.

2.question: Do you offer academic discounts?
2.answer: Yes, we offer special pricing for academic institutions, students, and non-profit research organizations. Please contact our sales team for more information.

3.question: What payment methods do you accept?
3.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), as well as invoicing for annual enterprise subscriptions.

4.question: Is there a free trial for the Pro plan?
4.answer: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial of our Pro plan, giving you full access to all Pro features without requiring payment information upfront.

5.question: What happens when I reach my query limit?
5.answer: When you reach your monthly query limit, you will be notified and have the option to upgrade to a higher tier. You won't lose any of your existing data or analyses.

6.question: How secure is my research data with Attma?
6.answer: We take data security very seriously. All data is encrypted both in transit and at rest. Enterprise plans include additional security features and compliance options such as HIPAA and GxP.
